description: OPEN REDIRECT CONFIRMED. /login?next=https://example.com and /login?next=//example.com/phish both send the browser off-site right after a successful real login (mapped defect auth #11). Playwright saw the top-level navigation request go to https://example.com/ and http://example.com/phish; the page ended on chrome-error only because this sandbox blocks outbound traffic.
expected: next accepts only same-origin relative paths (starting with a single "/" and not "//"); anything else falls back to /dashboard.
actual: router.replace(next) navigates to the attacker URL with the user freshly authenticated, which makes a convincing phishing chain.
suggested_fix: In login/page.tsx: const n = search.get("next"); const safe = n && n.startsWith("/") && !n.startsWith("//") && !n.startsWith("/\\") ? n : "/dashboard".

description: A mistyped dashboard URL (/dashboard/patient/<id>) renders the bare Next.js "404 | This page could not be found." page with no sidebar, header, Log out or link home (mapped defect auth #23, confirmed). Signed out, /dashboard/xyz goes through login and then lands on the same bare 404.
expected: A branded not-found inside the dashboard shell with "Go to Dashboard" and the nav still visible.
actual: White page with "404 | This page could not be found."; only the browser Back button helps.
suggested_fix: Add app/dashboard/not-found.tsx (inside the layout) and a root app/not-found.tsx with a home link.

description: On the patient Praneeta was sent (Arjun Reddy), the summary card says "Next appointment: Not scheduled" and the tracker offers "Book", but the History tab lists a Scheduled OPD appointment for today (07 Nov, 19:00) with Dr. Praneeta. GET /patients/:id/next-appointment returned 200 with an empty body (mapped patients defects #6 and #7, confirmed).
expected: Today's later appointment counts as upcoming, and the summary card shows it.
actual: Summary card and tracker say there is no appointment; History shows one.
suggested_fix: Compare on date+startTime in IST (not date >= now), and have findOne return nextAppointment (or read it from the tracker call).

description: The old /dashboard/billing bookmark lands a DOCTOR on "Pharmacy Billing", but no sidebar item is highlighted and doctors have no Pharmacy links, so there is no nav route back. The page also breaks the shell pattern: the h1 sits inside a tinted panel indented 12px from every other page title, and "Pharmacy Billing" appears twice (h1 and card title).
expected: Either restrict the redirect to roles that can reach the page, or keep the standard page header and highlight a nav item.
actual: No active nav item; duplicated title; offset header.

description: /dashboard/stock-predictions redirects to inventory?area=reorder&view=targets, which shows "Manual targets & exclusions", not "Target proposals" as the catalog says. The page also prints the raw branch id ("Branch branch-seed-1").
expected: Old "stock predictions" bookmarks open the proposal (prediction) view; branch shown by name.
actual: Manual targets editor; raw id text.

description: /test-transcribe ("Voice Transcription Test — Test the OpenAI Whisper transcription API") renders for a signed-out visitor and also sits in the DOCTOR sidebar under "Admin → Test Transcribe". It is a developer test page exposed in production nav and outside auth.
expected: Debug pages are removed, or gated to admins and covered by the middleware matcher.
actual: Page loads signed out; doctors see it in their nav.
suggested_fix: Delete the page or move it under /dashboard and gate by role; remove it from the sidebar.

description: The patient header shows the full internal id as a badge ("ID: cmw6dbbe2000a7dc1bw0xhc61") next to the human Code, and the Primary contact block prints a stray "—" (empty email) under the phone. Name, gender, age and phone repeat in header badges, summary card and Info tab.
expected: Show the patient Code; keep the internal id behind a copy affordance; hide empty rows.
actual: A 25-char cuid badge dominates the header; orphan dash.

description: At 390px the patient progress tracker (Start / Document / Complete / Prescribe / Billing / Follow-up) is cut off after "Complete". The last three steps are off-screen with no scroll affordance.
expected: Steps wrap, shrink to icons, or scroll with a visible affordance.
actual: Half the tracker is invisible on a phone.
